name: 12522-gsm8kbatch-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct, bf16 and unquantised (torch_dtype bfloat16, no quantization_config key). 15.7B total / 2.4B active parameters, ~30 GB of weights.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 1280 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: gsm8k five-shot, replayed from configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-1319.jsonl -- the 1319 questions of the test split, single turn over /v1/completions. Every prompt opens with the same 808-token five-shot preamble and then carries its own question, so whole prompts are 833-999 tokens (mean 871) and only ~63 per request are new; greedy (temperature 0), max_tokens 512, stopping on `Question` / `Assistant:` / `<|separator|>`, answers ~130 tokens.
purpose: A grade-school math tutor solving word problems with a shared worked-example preamble, 64 concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# SGLang ServerArgs. host / port / served-model-name are owned by whatever starts the server and
# waits on /health, so they are deliberately absent here.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1
enable-deterministic-inference: true

# What deterministic mode selects by itself on an SM90 card, pinned so a runtime capability probe
# cannot make two runs differ. It is also one of only two backends this mode accepts that keep the
# radix cache; the others force it off, which would throw the shared five-shot preamble away.
attention-backend: fa3

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
context-length: 4096
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42

# The radix cache and CUDA graphs stay ON, at the engine's own defaults, and are deliberately not
# written here: a `false` boolean is dropped when the command line is built, so `disable-radix-
# cache: false` would be a no-op that reads as a setting.
